notes:
I couldn't write the notes for Ezekiel 24. I didn't manage to read a single source page, so I have nothing I can report.

I tried to open six verse-by-verse sources at once: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, NET Bible notes, and Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub. A bug in my own script stopped it before it could show any of the page text. I then hit the limit on how many times I can run the research tool in one reply, so I couldn't retry.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I didn't read any of them, I've left out all the points rather than write unsourced notes or attach URLs I didn't check.

If you ask me to continue, I'll start over and:
1. Read the main verse-by-verse sources and take notes for each verse from 1 to 27: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Matthew Henry and others on Bible Hub and StudyLight.
2. Look at the passages where readings tend to differ, using each tradition's own sites:
   - the date of the siege (vv. 1–2)
   - the rusted pot (vv. 6–13)
   - the death of Ezekiel's wife and his being told not to mourn (vv. 15–24)
   - his muteness ending (vv. 25–27)
3. Add other views only where I find them: NET Bible notes, Bible Odyssey, and Catholic or Orthodox sources such as New Advent (including Church Fathers like Jerome on Ezekiel), Catholic.com and OCA.

Every point will have the URL of the page it came from.
